Continuous reading

Reading segment one. A walker leaves the village at sunrise and follows a narrow path beside the river. The water moves slowly past the trees, and the first light reaches the bridge.

Reading segment two. At the bridge, the walker pauses to watch a small boat. Its owner checks a rope, folds a blanket, and places a basket beneath the seat before setting off downstream.

Reading segment three. Beyond the bridge stands a garden with a wooden gate. A neighbour opens it and points toward a bench where visitors can sit and listen to the birds in the orchard.

Reading segment four. The path climbs a gentle hill behind the orchard. From the top, the walker can see the village roofs, the river bend, and a field where two horses graze near a hedge.

Reading segment five. A breeze arrives as the walker returns toward the village. Leaves move across the path, a window opens above the bakery, and someone carries fresh bread to a table outside.

Reading segment six. The walker reaches the starting point and rests beside the garden gate. This is the final numbered reading segment. Continuous reading should reach this text if it has not been interrupted.
